about.en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) is a price-weighted index of 30 large US blue-chip companies, excluding transportation and utilities, published by S&P Dow Jones Indices since 1896. Crypto venues list perpetuals on it under tickers such as US30. The DJIA is an index reference, not a token, fund share or redeemable basket; funds tracking it, such as the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust (DIA), are separate assets.
